summary: Iter-20 — Avatar Favorites end-to-end PASS. Backend: 10/10 pytests pass (auth gating, CRUD with persistence, $addToSet idempotency, 400 on empty avatar_id, cleanup, voice-favs regression). Frontend: full E2E flow verified via Playwright on live preview URL — modal opens with 27 avatar-cards (9:16 filter on), 27 avatar-fav star buttons in top-left, ★ tab present; star click flips to is-on/aria-pressed=true with card.is-favorite WITHOUT closing the modal (stopPropagation works); ★ tab shows only the favorited card with aspect-filter dropdown disabled; reload persists the favorite via backend; pin-to-top on All tab puts the favorite at index 0. Found and FIXED a blocking bug on /api/studio/avatars — httpx timeout=30 was insufficient for HeyGen's 1281-avatar response (upstream takes ~65s), so the cache could never populate and the endpoint always 500'd. Bumped to httpx.Timeout(90,connect=10). After cache warm, public URL serves in <200ms.

minor.issue: Cold cache fetch from HeyGen takes ~60-65s which exceeds the public ingress 60s limit — first request after a 24h cache expiry will return ingress 502 to the browser even though the backend successfully completes and stores the cache. Backend httpx timeout fixed (30→90s) so the cache write succeeds; subsequent public calls are then served from cache in <200ms. Consider adding a startup task / cron that warms heygen_avatars_v2 + heygen_voices in the background so users never see a cold-miss latency.

issues: React console warning: validateDOMNesting — <button class='avatar-fav'> is nested inside the avatar-card <button>. Functionally works (stopPropagation handles the event correctly) but invalid HTML. Replace the outer <button class='avatar-card'> with a <div role='button' tabIndex={0}> + onKeyDown handler, or render the star OUTSIDE the card button as an absolutely-positioned sibling.

Changed timeout to httpx.Timeout(90, connect=10) in _heygen_get. Cache now populates correctly; subsequent serve from Mongo cache.db in 20ms locally / <200ms via public URL.

action_items: Optional: add a startup or scheduled task to pre-warm heygen_avatars_v2 / heygen_voices cache so the first user of the day doesn't hit a 60s+ HeyGen cold call (currently the public ingress can 502 even though backend completes).
Fix React validateDOMNesting warning in AvatarPicker — refactor either the card or the star to not be a <button> inside a <button> (semantic + a11y win).

Extract a useFavorites(endpoint) custom hook to dedupe. The favorites loading effect is duplicated almost line-for-line between the two pickers.

Backend: avatar-favorites and voice-favorites endpoints share 95% identical code (4 endpoints × ~12 lines each = 48 LOC of near-duplication on db.buyers updates with the same $addToSet/$pull/$setOnInsert/$set shape). Factor into a single _toggle_favorite(field, value) helper.

_heygen_get is the only HeyGen client wrapper and is now used by /avatars, /voices, render polling, etc. The 90s timeout is conservative for /avatars but excessive for the latency-sensitive render-status polls. Consider passing per-call timeout overrides.

Cache miss UX: the AvatarPicker modal shows 'Loading avatars...' for 60+ seconds on first call of the day with no progress indicator or error fallback. Add a 502/timeout retry banner so users don't think the app is broken.

rca of the issue: Pre-existing /api/studio/avatars bug surfaced during this iter's frontend test: httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30) in _heygen_get() at server.py L313 was too tight for HeyGen v2 /avatars which returns 1281 avatars (~512KB) in ~65s. Result: every cache-miss request raised httpx.ReadTimeout -> 500 from FastAPI -> 'Loading avatars...' forever in the picker. Reproduction: GET /api/studio/avatars with valid bearer when cache is empty -> consistent 500 at ~30s. Mitigation applied: raised timeout to httpx.Timeout(90, connect=10) -- enough headroom for HeyGen's measured 65s. Side-effect on public ingress: first cold request from the browser will still get a 502 if it crosses the ingress 60s cap, but the backend now completes and writes the cache, so the second request succeeds in <200ms. Long-term fix recommended: background pre-warm of the HeyGen avatars/voices caches on backend startup.
